findings.finding: Air tool installed via `go install github.com/air-verse/air@latest` without version pin; latest may break builds or contain unknown changes.
findings.recommendation: Pin Air to a specific version in go.mod or use `go install github.com/air-verse/air@v1.26.0` (or latest stable) and add to module verification; or pin via go.mod require.

findings.finding: Makefile defines `DATABASE_URL ?= postgres://abys:abys@localhost:5432/abys?sslmode=disable` as a default, embedding database credentials directly in the committed Makefile.
findings.recommendation: Remove the default value or replace with a placeholder that forces operators to set DATABASE_URL via environment; never commit real credentials.

findings.finding: `.gitignore` contains `+/tmp/` which force-adds the tmp directory to version control, potentially overriding intentional gitignore rules and exposing temporary files.
findings.recommendation: Replace `+/tmp/` with `/tmp/` (without the `+` prefix) to only gitignore without forcing addition; review if any tmp contents should be tracked.

summary: 3 findings: 2 info, 1 low. No block severities. Key observations: air@latest without pin (informational), Makefile default DATABASE_URL with credentials (low), .gitignore +/tmp/ forcing add (informational). Air unit properly uses EnvironmentFile, NoNewPrivileges, PrivateTmp, ProtectSystem=full, ReadWritePaths limited to src/bin (no data). --with-air guard validates go toolchain and DATABASE_URL placeholder.
